title: Figure 41: Frequency of Object Sightings by Local Sun Time, One-Hour Intervals
description: Histogram of the "Number of Object Sightings" (0–300) by "Local Sun Time" in one-hour intervals from 0000 to 2400, with dashed markers at Midnight, Noon and Midnight. An outline histogram shows "All object sightings" and a grid-hatched histogram shows "Unknown object sightings"; both peak around 2000–2100 hours. Caption: "FIGURE 41 FREQUENCY OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY LOCAL SUN TIME, INTERVALS OF ONE HOUR"; drawing A-7537.
